Name: Kozmi Oz
Title: The Eater World
Information:
**Kozmi Oz**

**Title** The Eater World
**Gemstone** Kimberlite
**Type** Hyperanael
**Originator** Jenvaj

Kozmi Oz is what remains of a planet that was infested by Jenvaj and consumed. This planet was a living organism which, after being stripped of its inhabitants, was reduced down in scale and granted eidolic power by Jenvaj and brought under its thrall. It exists to travel across the universe consuming life in Jenvaj’s place. Its most common approach is to find planets teeming with eternal life, and bury itself deep inside of them, where it begins to consume and sap life from it from within. After the planet is reduced to a shell, Jenvaj is usually not far behind, ready to attack and integrate the weakened life left on the ravaged world.

Kozmi Oz is one interstellar entity that Arc Valinn concerns itself with and sends its followers to keep an eye on, restrain, or divert the hungering planetoid.

“I couldn’t handle this thing. In ancient times I lost a lair to it, and could do nothing to stop it. I've worked hard to rebuild since then.”

Stat Blocks.title: Kozmi Oz
Stat Blocks.ability_note: Checks, saves and skills include the +2 cosmogony bonus.

traits.name: Cosmogony Bonus (+4)
traits.description: Half of Kozmi Oz’s Cosmogony Bonus is added to their attack rolls, ability checks, damage rolls, and saving throws. The full bonus is added to their armor class. The bonus to their attack rolls, saving throws, damage rolls, and armor class is accounted for in this stat block.

traits.name: Gravity Horizon
traits.description:
Kozmi Oz can adjust all gravity within 500 feet of it. At the start of each its turns, it can choose to turn this area into regular gravity, a low-gravity environment, or a zero-gravity environment.

When a creature attempts to leave the area of the planetoid’s Gravity Horizon, Kozmi Oz may force them to make a DC 24 Strength saving throw. On a failure, they are immediately pulled toward it by 100 feet plus their remaining movement, and cannot take any more movement until the end of their turn. If pulled into the air they are suspended in place until the start of their next turn, even if the area is not a low- or zero-gravity environment.

traits.name: Seraphic Authority: Density Space
traits.description: When hostile creatures move through the space affected by Kozmi Oz’s Gravity Horizon feature, they treat the area as difficult terrain. Ranged attacks treat that area as though each foot cost 2 feet of distance. Any creature unable to propel itself within the space, or those who are prone or unconscious, drift 60 feet toward Kozmi Oz at the start of each of their turns.

actions.name: Debris Crash
actions.description: Kozmi Oz chooses up to six targets within 120 feet of itself, and hurls orbiting debris at them as a Ranged Weapon Attack: +18 to hit. Hit: 32 (4d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage plus 26 (4d12) fire damage.

actions.name: Kimberlite Crust Bite
actions.description: Macro Melee Weapon Attack: +18 to hit, reach 50 ft., one target. Hit: 49 (6d12 + 10) piercing damage plus 55 (10d10) fire damage. If the attack exceeds the target’s armor class by 10 points or more, they are automatically grappled and restrained (escape DC 26). (macro: 82 piercing damage plus 100 fire damage)

actions.name: Molten Burst (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: Kozmi Oz ejects a burst of molten kimberlite and rock that explodes in a 120-foot-radius sphere at a point it can see within 480 feet. Each creature in that space (except Kozmi Oz) must make a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw (macro), taking 61 (6d12 + 22) fire damage on a failure, or half as much on a success (macro: 94 fire).

actions.name: Cosmic Shard: Kimberlite Starfall (Recharge 6)
actions.description:
Kozmi Oz chooses eight points it can see within 1 mile. At each of these points, a meteor made of burning, irritated material explodes in a 100-foot radius sphere centred there. Each target within one or more of these radiuses must make a DC 24 Dexterity or Constitution saving throw (their choice). Each target that fails takes 66 (10d12) fire damage and 66 (10d12) force damage, or half as much on a successful save. All unremarkable structures, flora, and fauna caught in these areas are immediately destroyed.

For each sphere that had at least one target within it, Kozmi Oz regains 33 (6d10) hit points.

legendary_actions.name: Seize Gravity
legendary_actions.description: Kozmi Oz chooses one creature within 1200 feet of it, which must make a DC 24 Strength saving throw. If the target fails while outside its Gravity Horizon, it is pulled up to 600 feet toward it. If it fails while inside it, the target’s movement speed is reduced to 0 until the end of the planetoid’s next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Debris Slam (Costs X Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Kozmi Oz chooses a number of creatures within 480 feet equal to the number of Legendary Actions it spends, and targets them as though using its Debris Crash action.

legendary_actions.name: Create Debris Storm (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Kozmi Oz creates an active debris field around itself with a density of 2d4 + 4 (maximum 10), which fills its Gravity Horizon. Kozmi Oz is immune to its own debris field, and may pass through it harmlessly. It immediately rolls a random Debris Event, which happens to every creature inside it. This field disappears at the end of Kozmi Oz’s next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Molten Ejection (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Kozmi Oz uses its Molten Burst action, or attempts to recharge it.
